purpose: Teach: のどか/ぶつぶつ/さぞかし/めでたく/ごろごろ/なつかしい/あてはまる/かわいらしい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがのどかな景色を描きたいって
lines.en: Sho, I'd really like to paint a peaceful landscape like this.
lines.style: Soft, warm opening. Gaze slightly distant—thinking aloud rather than speaking to him. Gentle rhythm, no rush. A quiet invitation, not a demand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ぶつぶつ独り言で覚え物をしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I memorized it by saying it over and over to myself.
lines.style: Small, matter-of-fact voice. A child reporting a discovery he's proud of but not performing it. Natural pace, ground-level honesty.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんと会えたらさぞかし喜ばれるわね
lines.en: Sho, if you showed Grandpa, he'd be so happy.
lines.style: Brightens noticeably. Warm, almost musical lilt in the thought. Leaning forward with genuine pleasure—imagining his face. A little more energy than before.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、めでたくピアノコンクールで入賞したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I actually won a prize in the piano competition!
lines.style: Voice lifts with real joy—not forced. Quick, eager delivery. The words tumble out because he needs her to know right now. Genuine six-year-old delight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お休みの日はメイ姉さんとごろごろしましょう
lines.en: On your days off, let's just lie around together, you and me.
lines.style: Tender, almost conspiratorial whisper. Cozy invitation—no urgency, just comfort. Slow, easy pacing. The voice of someone who's made a small safe space.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、メイ姉さんの絵本、なつかしい絵柄ね
lines.en: Your picture book, Mei-sis—I'd forgotten how much I loved those drawings.
lines.style: Gentle, almost surprised recognition. Soft nostalgia in the voice. Pause-space around the memories. Speaking as if he's just remembered something precious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの予想が翔くんにあてはまるか分からないわね
lines.en: I wonder if what I'm guessing about you actually fits, Sho.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly uncertain. Speaking more to herself than to him. A quiet pause before the admission. The tone of someone reconsidering something she thought she knew.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんが「かわいらしい孫」って言ってくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandma told me I'm her cute little grandchild.
lines.style: Shy delight—his voice small but glowing. Pride mixed with the sweetness of being loved out loud. No boasting, just wanting to share the warmth.
